darija_text: واحد قال لصاحبو: "شفتي داك الراجل لي لهيه كيشبه ليك بزاف؟" قال ليه: "وا راه خويا التوأم!" قال ليه: "وا علاش ما قلتيهاش ليا من الصباح وأنا كنسلّم عليه!"
transliteration: Wahed gal l sahbo: "Chefti dak rajel li lhih kaychbeh lik bzaf?" Gal lih: "Wa rah khoya tew'am!" Gal lih: "Wa 3lach ma geltihach liya men sba7 w ana kansellem 3lih!"
english_translation: A man told his friend: "See that man over there who looks exactly like you?" His friend replied: "Well, that is my twin brother!" The man said: "Why didn't you tell me? I've been waving and saying hello to him all morning!"

darija_text: الأستاذ سوّل التلميذ: "علاش كتدور الأرض؟" التلميذ جاوبو: "حيت ما لقاتش فين تجلس يا أستاذ!"
transliteration: Al-ostad sewel telmid: "3lach katdouer l-ard?" Telmid jawbo: "7it ma lqatch fin tjles a oustad!"
english_translation: The teacher asked the student: "Why does the Earth rotate?" The student answered: "Because it couldn't find a place to sit down, sir!"

darija_text: واحد مشا عند الطبيب قال ليه: "دكتور، كل ما كنشرب أتاي كضرني عيني ليمنية." قال ليه الطبيب: "حيد المعلقة من الكاس قبل ما تشرب!"
transliteration: Wahed mcha 3nd tbib gal lih: "Docteur, koul ma kanchreb atay katderni 3ayni limniya." Gal lih tbib: "7eyed l-me3elqa men l-kass qbel ma techreb!"
english_translation: A man visited the doctor and complained: "Doctor, every time I drink mint tea, my right eye stings." The doctor told him: "Take the spoon out of the glass before you drink!"

darija_text: مول الطاكسي ركب معاه واحد كيهضر بلا قياس. قال ليه الشيفور: "واش باغي تسمع الراديو ولا نهدرو؟" قال ليه الراكب: "نهدرو أحسن." قال ليه الشيفور: "إيوا سكت وخليني نسوق!"
transliteration: Moul taxi rkeb m3ah wahed kayehder bla qyas. Gal lih chauffeur: "Wach baghi tsm3 radio wla nehdro?" Gal lih rakeb: "Nehdro hsen." Gal lih chauffeur: "Iwa skout w khellini nsoug!"
english_translation: A taxi driver picked up an overly chatty passenger. The driver asked: "Do you want to listen to the radio or talk?" The passenger said: "Let's talk, that's better." The driver said: "Well then, shut up and let me drive!"

darija_text: واحد كايقلّب على تيليفونو وهو كيهضر بيه، وقال لصاحبو لي فالمكالمة: "بلاتي بلاتي، راه تلّفت التيليفون، بلاتي نقطع ونعاود نعيط ليك منين نلقاه!"
transliteration: Wahed kayqelleb 3la telephono w howa kayehder bih, w gal l sahbo li f lmoukalama: "Blati blati, rah telleft telephone, blati nqte3 w n3awed n3eyyet lik mnin nelqah!"
english_translation: A man was frantically looking everywhere for his phone while talking on it, and told his friend on the call: "Hold on, hold on! I misplaced my phone! Let me hang up and call you back once I find it!"

darija_text: واحد مشا للقهوة وقال للنادل: "عطيني قهوة كحلة بلا سكر وبلا حليب وبلا ماء." قال ليه النادل: "وبلا فيرطاس احسن، خود غير الحساب وسير بحالك!"
transliteration: Wahed mcha l l-qahwa w gal l-serbay: "3tini qahwa ke7la bla soukkar w bla 7lib w bla ma." Gal lih serbay: "W bla fertas hsen, khod ghir l-7issab w sir b7alek!"
english_translation: A customer went to a cafe and ordered: "Give me a black coffee without sugar, without milk, and without water." The waiter replied: "Even better, without coffee! Just pay the check and go home!"

darija_text: واحد سول صاحبو: "شنو هو الفرق بين التران والطيارة؟" قال ليه: "التران عندو السكة فالأرض والطيارة عندها السكة فالسما." قال ليه: "تبارك الله عليك، والمهندسين ضيعو قرايتهم فالفابور!"
transliteration: Wahed sewel sahbo: "Chnou howa l-ferq bin train w teyyara?" Gal lih: "Train 3ndo sekka f l-ard w teyyara 3ndha sekka f sma." Gal lih: "Tbrakellah 3lik, w l-mouhandisin dey3ou qrayethom f l-fabor!"
english_translation: A man asked his friend: "What is the difference between a train and an airplane?" His friend answered: "A train has its tracks on the ground, and an airplane has its tracks in the sky." The first replied: "Bravo! All those engineers studied years for nothing!"

darija_text: فالمقابلة د الخدمة، سولوه: "شنو هي أكبر نقطة ضعف عندك؟" قال ليهم: "الصراحة الزايدة." قالو ليه: "ما كنضنوش باللي الصراحة نقطة ضعف." قال ليهم: "سوقكم هذاك، ما كيهمنيش رأيكم!"
transliteration: F l-moqabala d l-khedma, sewlouh: "Chnou hiya kber noqtat do3f 3ndek?" Gal lihom: "S-sara7a z-zayda." Galou lih: "Ma kandennouch belli s-sara7a noqtat do3f." Gal lihom: "Souqkoum hadak, ma kayhemmich ra'ykoum!"
english_translation: In a job interview, they asked him: "What is your greatest weakness?" He answered: "Extreme honesty." They said: "We don't consider honesty a weakness." He said: "That's your business, I couldn't care less what you think!"

darija_text: واحد كيتفرج فماتش د الكورة ومغمض عينيه. سولو صاحبو: "مالك مغمض عينيك؟" قال ليه: "باغي نتفاجأ بالبيت فاش يتمارك!"
transliteration: Wahed kaytferrej f match d l-koura w mghemmed 3aynih. Sewlou sahbo: "Malek mghemmed 3aynik?" Gal lih: "Baghi ntfaja' b l-bit fach ytmarka!"
english_translation: A man was watching a soccer match with his eyes shut tight. His friend asked: "Why are you closing your eyes?" He replied: "I want to be surprised when a goal is scored!"

darija_text: واحد لابس ربعة د الجواكي فاش كان البرد، سولو صاحبو: "واش كتخاف من البرد لهاد الدرجة؟" قال ليه: "لا، غير السنسلة ديال اللولة خاسرة وما بغاتش تسد!"
transliteration: Wahed labes reb3a d jwaki fach kan l-berd, sewlou sahbo: "Wach katkhaf men l-berd l had d-daraja?" Gal lih: "La, ghir s-sensla dyal l-loula khasra w ma bghatch tsd!"
english_translation: A man was wearing four heavy jackets during cold winter weather. His friend asked: "Are you that terrified of catching a cold?" He replied: "No, it's just that the zipper on the first jacket is broken and won't close!"
